title: Strategies
description: The strategy registry as published (MOD-03, DL-86): every registered strategy — a forecaster paired with a decision policy — generated from the committed files under config/strategies/. Every per-strategy artefact names its strategy by the id and digest listed here. Additive in contract v1.

champion.description: The id of the one strategy whose role is champion: the live advice.

strategies.description: Champion first, then by role, published before unpublished, then by id.

id.description: Stable; never reused, never a role name.

published.description: Runs every refresh and appears in the app.

aliases.description: Legacy ids that mean this strategy: the frozen harness's key and the app's old model ids.

digest.description: sha256 over the registry entry and the run config sections it reads, as canonical JSON, and the source that decides its advice: it changes whenever any of the three does.

plan.description: Whether the strategy gets the multi-gameweek plan and chips.

artefacts.description: Where the app finds this strategy's published week and plan, relative to the data directory; null where it publishes none. The app reads these paths and never builds one.
